properties.summary: The report relates smoke size and morphology to material, flow and aging. Based on that experience the SAME-R investigation employed several modification covering new materials, extended operating conditions, and diagnostic equipments.

SAME-R utilized the SAME hardware used on-orbit. SAME-R flight tests were conducted from July 16, to September 9, 2010, successfully completing 66 test points.
